core_roles.description: Turns the owner's intent into small, testable stories with a risk level.

core_roles.name: architect
core_roles.description: Keeps parts consistent: architecture note, ADRs, the verification command.

core_roles.name: developer
core_roles.description: Implements one story test-first, runs the verification command, stops.

core_roles.name: reviewer
core_roles.description: Runs the verification command that decides Done, checks the tests, adds the adversarial pass on high risk; never edits code.
